feature_name: UI 无响应看门狗日志
reuse: UI 无响应诊断必须复用 UiHangWatchdog 的后台心跳检查，不要在 UI 线程高频写日志。新增 UI 长路径检查点应调用 MarkUiCheckpoint，并保持操作名稳定可检索。该机制只记录 UI 线程卡死时最后检查点，不能替代 WER dump；不要把敏感数据写入 current_operation。

feature_name: Codex Radar 渲染变体切换
window_page: Codex Radar 设置页 - 渲染变体
reuse: 新增 Codex Radar 视觉变体时，在 Core/CodexRadarForm.<Name>.cs 新建 partial class CodexRadarForm 文件，只放该变体自己的 Draw 方法；圆环/标签复用 DrawEvenLayoutQuotaCell/IqCell/EfficiencyCell/RadarCell 和 GetEvenLayoutCellRects，额度取数复用 GatherQuotaDisplayState。CodexRadarRenderVariant 枚举加成员后，DrawCodexRadarModules 顶部 switch 分支调用对应变体；删除变体时删除对应文件并去掉分支。该机制只切换绘制路径，不改变数据获取、线程模型或持久化状态。EvenGrid/EvenRow 均不响应 CodexRadarManualLayoutEnabled 和 CodexRadar*Offset* 设置，网格由窗口尺寸自动等分。当前旧五阶段连接摘要已删除，变体不得再引用旧连接摘要方法。

reuse: 把 codex_radar.render_variant_switch 的 partial-class + 枚举设置 + 分发模式推广到全部 5 个悬浮窗口：主窗口 WidgetForm、网络监控 NetworkMonitorForm、功耗温度 PowerThermalForm、连接检测 ConnectionCheckForm、操作面板 OperationForm。每个窗口独立枚举（MainWidget/NetworkMonitor/PowerThermal/ConnectionCheck/Operation RenderVariant），目前都只有 Classic 一个成员；对应窗口的内容绘制方法（DrawWidgetContent/DrawContent/DrawOperationWindow）改为顶部 switch 分发，经典实现移到 *Classic 方法。新增某窗口的变体：给该窗口枚举加成员、新建 <Form>.<Name>.cs（partial class，只放绘制方法、复用该窗口既有数据/字段）、在其分发 switch 加 case；删除变体=删文件+去 case。设置页各窗口都加了“渲染变体”下拉（当前只有经典布局），EnumOption/字段说明/VerifySelfTest 必需绑定同步。该机制只切换绘制路径，不改数据获取/线程/持久化；跨窗口共享的绘制资源仍是 DesignTokens/UiFontCache 等。

feature_name: OLED 安全无蓝色渲染变体（排版流/暗琥珀仪表/暖灰暗卡片/磷光绿终端）
window_page: 所有窗口设置页 - 渲染变体（现含经典布局 + 4 套 OLED 安全方案，CodexRadar 另加均布六格/均布单行）
module: Core.OledVariantPainting; Core.WidgetForm; Core.NetworkMonitorForm; Core.PowerThermalForm; Core.ConnectionCheckForm; Core.OperationForm; Core.CodexRadarForm; Settings.WidgetSettings; Settings.Win11SettingsForm
reuse: 用户明确要求：背景保持现有半透明不变，四套配色方案都不得使用蓝色（OLED 蓝色子像素老化最快），防烧屏靠已有的 BurnInProtection.ApplyRuntimeOffset 整窗周期性像素位移实现全屏均匀老化，不依赖任何局部纯黑或每方案专属的特例逻辑。四套方案：Typographic=无边框无填充，数值堆叠在标签上方，发丝线分隔；AmberHud=单一琥珀色细描边徽章，等宽字体；WarmCard=低亮度暖灰实心卡片+语义色圆点；Phosphor=单一暗绿终端风格 prefix:value 文本行，零形状。六个窗口（主窗口/网络监控/功耗温度/连接检测/操作面板/CodexRadar）各自的 RenderVariant 枚举都新增了这 4 个成员（CodexRadar 额外保留原有 EvenGrid/EvenRow）。CleanIP/CodexRadar/NetworkMonitor/PowerThermal/WidgetForm 都遵循同一模式：新建 <Window>.OledShared.cs 做数据/严重度提取（不复用 Classic 的调色板函数，因为那些函数内部可能硬编码蓝色，必须从原始数值/状态枚举独立推导 severity），再各配 4 个 <Window>.<Scheme>.cs 只放绘制。CodexRadar 的额度雷达趋势线、WidgetForm 的迷你曲线图这类图表内容不转成纯文字，而是复用原有绘制函数并新增 dotColorOverride/Color[] 重新着色参数，避免破坏仅有的时序可视化内容。OperationForm 的按钮图形（Start 徽标、AI Studio 闪光、任务管理器趋势线等）同理：保留全部图标线稿，只给内部硬编码 DesignTokens.Colors.Accent/AccentAlt/AccentGradientEnd 的地方新增可选颜色参数重载（2 参数版本保持 Classic 原色不变）。渲染自检：--render-connectioncheck 和 --render-codexradar 复用已有入口扩展了新变体；--render-networkmonitor/--render-powerthermal/--render-widget/--render-operation 为本次新增的 4 个渲染自检命令，均为 test-only，不影响正常运行路径。新增第 5 套方案时：在 DesignTokens 加调色板 nested class，在 6 个窗口枚举各加成员，在 OledVariantPainting 按需加新原语，每窗口新建一个 <Window>.<Name>.cs 只放绘制方法。

feature_name: Codex Radar DeepSeek 余额状态行

reuse: DeepSeek API key 只从 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 进程/用户/机器环境变量或本地 deepseek-api-key.txt 读取，禁止写入 settings.ini、日志、维护记录或索引。余额接口只读取 CNY total_balance；DeepSeek 官方未提供 24h 用量接口时，deepseek-balance-history.jsonl 仍保留最近 48h 样本供诊断和后续复用，但当前 DS 文本不再用 24h 估算消耗、余额阈值或高低峰改变颜色。 1.0.3.49 设置页 DeepSeek 配置入口只写 deepseek-api-key.txt，保存或清除后递增 DeepSeekApiKeyRevision 触发即时刷新；API key 不得写入 settings.ini、日志、维护记录或索引。 1.0.3.52 DeepSeek 本地 API key 配置入口从“网站数据源”移动到设置页 Codex Radar 的“模型与时区”组；仍只写 deepseek-api-key.txt 并递增 DeepSeekApiKeyRevision，不把密钥写入 settings.ini。 1.0.3.54 DS display moved from the EvenRow right status cell into the lower-left metadata strip; refresh cadence and key storage are unchanged. 1.0.3.55 删除 DS 显示颜色规则：底部 DS 元信息不再按余额、24h 本地估算消耗或高低峰变色，而与 RC/LLM/SF 共用 RC 灰色和白色折中的中性灰白；文本追加北京时间高峰/低谷，高峰集中定义为 09:00-12:00 与 14:00-18:00，其余为低谷；底部元信息字号统一放大 20%。 1.0.3.57 DS 底部文本随 RC/LLM/SF 一起由 DrawEvenRowBottomInfoPanel 分配独立测量矩形，使用 GetEvenRowBottomInfoRects/GetEvenRowBottomInfoFont 适配字号，避免被横线或相邻模块遮挡。 1.0.3.58 DS 所在底部元信息条改为贴近窗口底部绘制，避免真实窗口高度下因灰线下方空间不足而整条不可见。 1.0.3.59 DS 所在底部元信息条随 RC/LLM/SF 一起在灰线到底边的整段高度内上下居中，字体基准再放大 30%。

feature_name: 应用窗口、任务栏和任务管理器图标

recommended_test_commands: powershell icon extraction check for ExtractAssociatedIcon and Form.Icon
reuse: 托盘、Form.Icon 和 exe Win32 图标必须保持同一视觉标识。修改图标时先改 ApplicationIcon 绘制逻辑，再同步重新生成 Assets/AppIcon.ico；构建脚本必须继续通过 /win32icon 嵌入该 ico，否则任务管理器仍会显示默认 exe 图标。AppIcon.ico 使用传统 BGRA/DIB 多尺寸帧而不是 PNG-only ICO，以兼容更多 Windows 外壳缓存/解析路径。设置窗口 ShowInTaskbar=true 时必须设置 Icon，避免任务栏和 Alt+Tab 显示默认 WinForms 图标。

feature_name: Codex Radar ChatGPT usage provider 额度读取
reuse: CODEX 模式必须优先使用 chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage 的 provider 快照；provider 无 token、请求失败、解析失败或快照超过约 15 分钟时才回退到本地 session/quota.ini。provider 请求必须后台单飞，不能在绘制路径或 UI timer 中同步阻塞；access token 只从环境变量或 auth.json 读取，不写回、不刷新、不记录。额度状态应用必须复用 ApplyCodexQuotaSnapshot，保持 reset 保护、消耗环判定和 quota-decision-history 日志一致。额度环中央数字不再按 CODEX/CLAUDE 家族染色；已知数值在任一受支持本地软件运行时为白色，只有两者都停或无数值时才灰显。1.0.3.79 启动/恢复、网络变化、手动刷新、软件切换和测试恢复必须通过 RequestSelectedQuotaUsageRefresh 门控，不能直接 prime Codex provider。 1.0.4.10 Codex/Claude software and model switching now captures the current display state in memory before changing effective family. The switch-in path restores target-family same-model memory cache, then disk cache, and otherwise keeps the previous visible snapshot/quota until the new website/quota request succeeds, preventing transient empty/error UI. 1.0.4.19 provider parser treats used_percent/used_percentage as percentage units and only treats utilization 0..1 as a fraction; suspicious single-sample provider drops from a high balance to 0 without a material reset advance are rejected before memory/cache writes and logged for diagnosis.

feature_name: Codex Radar Claude 用量缓存与统一额度处理
reuse: CLAUDE 模式只允许获取逻辑与 CODEX 不同；成功获取后必须写入独立 claude-quota.ini，并进入 ApplyCodexQuotaSnapshot 共用 reset 保护、消耗环判定、quota-decision-history 日志和绘制状态。切换软件时必须加载对应软件的额度缓存并重置本轮消耗环跟踪，避免 CODEX/CLAUDE 显示串扰。1.0.3.78 起独立 Claude Radar 也读取 claude-quota.ini 作为个人 5h/7d 余额显示，公开站点 usage 只作无个人缓存时的 fallback。1.0.3.79 Claude usage 只能由 selected-provider gate 在有效软件为 CLAUDE 且 Claude 本地程序运行时排队，启动/恢复不得绕过门控。 1.0.3.83 Independent Claude Radar uses the shared ClaudeCodeUsageReader path to write/read claude-quota.ini for personal quota display; Codex Radar keeps its selected-provider gate while the standalone Claude window has its own fixed-family gate. 1.0.3.84 Claude quota cache writes now use the shared ClaudeRadarReader.TryWriteClaudeCodeQuotaCache atomic writer. Readers require both FiveHourPercent and WeeklyPercent, and Claude Radar website cache no longer persists overlaid personal quota. 1.0.3.93 ClaudeCodeUsageReader parses top-level OAuth usage slots, newer limits-array slots, and Messages API anthropic-ratelimit-unified headers as a fallback; cache writes still require both 5h and 7d percentages and store remaining percentages, not raw utilization. 1.0.3.96 ClaudeCodeUsageReader setup-token source is shared by Codex Radar Claude mode and standalone Claude Radar; local claude-quota.ini semantics stay unchanged after a successful read. 1.0.4.00 Claude Code personal usage defaults to the passive statusline bridge: Read() reads claude-statusline-quota.ini and installs desktop-codex-statusline-bridge.ps1 only when no custom Claude Code statusLine exists. This default path does not call Claude API/model endpoints and does not spend Claude tokens. ReadViaSetupToken keeps the abandoned setup-token/OAuth/Header parser as a non-default rollback path only. 1.0.4.01 Statusline bridge script is Windows PowerShell 5.1 compatible; do not use ConvertFrom-Json -Depth in the generated powershell.exe script because that parameter prevents any cache write on the target shell. 1.0.4.10 Codex/Claude software and model switching now captures the current display state in memory before changing effective family. The switch-in path restores target-family same-model memory cache, then disk cache, and otherwise keeps the previous visible snapshot/quota until the new website/quota request succeeds, preventing transient empty/error UI. 1.0.4.29 Codex Radar Claude mode and standalone Claude Radar must enqueue Claude Code usage through ClaudeCodeUsageScheduler, not call ClaudeCodeUsageReader.Read directly. The scheduler provides process-wide single-flight, shared 5/10/15 min backoff, one claude-quota.ini write per successful round, and host-only logging for setup-token fallback requests.

aliases: 左下角双击 AI 阻断
window_page: 系统设置; 操作面板; Codex Radar
recommended_test_commands: Do not trigger the operation-panel manual AI block path in automated tests
reuse: 自动模式默认开启，但只复用 NetworkMonitorReader 已有 GFW 明确阻断结论；没有结论时不新增探测、不写系统代理、不写防火墙规则。手动模式由设置或操作面板程序设置按钮双击确认后切换；开启时本程序请求守卫阻断 OpenAI/ChatGPT/Claude/Anthropic 目标，并尝试停止正在运行的 Codex/Claude Code 外部进程。敏感端点新增时必须统一接入 AiRequestProtection.ShouldBlock，避免散落判断。 1.0.3.83 ClaudeCodeUsageReader calls AiRequestProtection.ShouldBlock before reading OAuth tokens or creating the Anthropic usage request.

feature_name: Codex Radar 运行态快照与探测门控
aliases: 程序未启动不检测前台
个人额度 provider 门控
window_page: Codex Radar 窗口; Claude Radar 窗口; Claude Radar SPEC
reuse: Auto 软件族选择必须先读 SoftwareRuntimePresence 快照：固定模式、两者都未运行或仅一者运行时不得查询前台窗口；只有 Codex 与 Claude 都运行时才调用前台窗口检测。个人额度刷新由 RequestSelectedQuotaUsageRefresh 统一门控，启动/恢复、网络变化、手动刷新、软件切换和测试恢复不得同时 prime 或排队 Codex provider 与 Claude usage。额度环数字颜色只表达本地受支持软件运行态：有数值且任一受支持软件运行时白色，两者都停或无数值时灰色；绘制路径只读最近快照，不枚举进程。1.0.3.77 独立 Claude Radar 窗口也复用 SoftwareRuntimePresence，但只在构造、设置应用、手动刷新和性能模式定时器中刷新本地快照；ClaudeRadarForm 绘制路径只读缓存快照，公共 Claude Radar 网站数据不按本地 Codex/Claude 进程状态门控。1.0.3.79 启动/恢复 priming 删除两套 provider 直写 helper，统一走 selected-provider gate。 1.0.3.88 --test now covers fixed Codex/Claude modes, no-app and one-app presence, both-app foreground detection/failure fallback, and selected-provider quota refresh targets. 1.0.3.90 WidgetForm owns independent CodexRadarEnabled/ClaudeRadarEnabled child-window lifecycle, so only-Codex, only-Claude, and both-window production runtime matrices are expressible without creating disabled radar windows.

window_page: Claude Radar 独立窗口; 设置页 Claude Radar
reuse: 独立 Claude Radar 默认关闭，启用后由 WidgetForm 创建 ClaudeRadarForm。窗口使用 claudecoderadar.com data JSON 和 model-ratings 接口，模型映射与缓存全部使用 ClaudeRadar/claude-radar 前缀文件；余额环优先读取 claude-quota.ini 个人 Claude Code 用量缓存，站点公开 quota usage 只作无个人缓存时的 fallback。场景 bitmap 缓存最多 6 张，绘制路径不做网络/磁盘/进程枚举。模型映射编辑器只允许修改 display_name、rating_key、sort_order 和 enabled；新增/暂缺/恢复/删除通知按 source_key 与事件状态去重。公共 Claude Radar JSON、model-ratings 和站点额度线数据不受本地 Codex/Claude 运行态门控；额度数字已知且任一受支持软件运行时为白色，无数值或两者都停时灰色。 1.0.3.80 设置页 ClaudeRadarModelKey 已切换为五列按钮网格：每行五槽，空槽为禁用 --，自动为空 key，active/enabled 模型可选，pending/temporarily_missing/deleted/disabled 模型只显示但不可选；映射编辑器保存后重建网格并保留当前 key。 1.0.3.81 ClaudeRadarReader no longer guesses rating_key from display_name. source_key and rating_key are separate external namespaces; new models, empty rating_key rows, and explicit keys missing from an available ratings catalog remain pending. Only explicit non-empty rating_key rows confirmed by the ratings API, or rows checked while that API is unavailable, can become active. SaveModelMap and the internal writer normalize enabled rows without rating_key to pending. 1.0.3.82 Post-review hardening: persisted enabled rows with empty rating_key are forced to pending even if status was active, and the settings selectors require non-empty rating_key before a source_key is selectable. 1.0.3.83 Independent Claude Radar now refreshes Claude Code usage while enabled/visible/not suspended/not random-test and local Claude is running. Success writes claude-quota.ini and immediately updates quota rings; LoadCache overlays the latest claude-quota.ini so startup does not show stale website-cache quota. 1.0.3.84 Claude Radar saves public website quota only with QuotaSource=site, overlays personal claude-quota.ini after cache save, and ignores legacy cache quota fields without that source marker. 1.0.3.85 Homepage metadata fallback is sequential and weak: only when data JSON fails, iq.models is missing, or model names are missing/key-only does ClaudeRadarReader fetch the homepage and parse MODEL_NAMES. Homepage metadata must not fabricate IQ/quota data and must not delete or temporarily-miss existing model-map rows. 1.0.3.85 ClaudeRadarHomepageFallbackEnabled gates the sequential homepage MODEL_NAMES metadata fallback; disabled means no homepage request, enabled still treats homepage-only catalogs as weak and non-deleting. 1.0.3.86 Claude Radar service squares map R/C/U to Radar data, Claude public Statuspage summary, and Claude Code usage; incomplete/unavailable/unreachable draw gray/yellow/red crosses. Complete model catalogs now require ok=true and a fully parseable iq.models list before MissingSuccessCount can advance; quota-history selftests cover duplicate signatures, malformed JSONL tolerance, and trimming. 1.0.3.87 --render-clauderadar now emits deterministic normal, missing-data, warning, error, offline, and test-randomized fixture images plus matching 2880x1800 desktop composites; --test-layout runs ClaudeRadarForm.RunRenderResourceSelfTest for nonblank state renders, scene-cache cap, and render-buffer/cache disposal. Unknown model metrics render time/token efficiency as muted -- instead of default 100. 1.0.3.87 --diagnose-radar-runtime records current-process CPU, memory, handle, GDI, and USER samples for the remaining live performance matrix. 1.0.3.88 --test includes Claude Radar reader failure fixtures plus temporary-root storage isolation/no-write checks; --test-layout includes notification de-dup, last-good failure merge, and public-refresh single-flight fixtures. 1.0.3.89 --diagnose-radar-runtime can sample a running formal process with --diagnose-target-pid and scenario labels. 1.0.3.90 CodexRadarEnabled defaults true and lets WidgetForm close Codex Radar when disabled, so only-Claude production sampling uses CodexRadarEnabled=false with ClaudeRadarEnabled=true. --test-layout covers 120-cycle high-frequency scene cache hits; --test-settings-open-close and --test-radar-display-lifecycle cover settings/lifecycle resource deltas. 1.0.3.91 The shared transition Codex Radar window reuses ClaudeRadarReader for Claude mode and falls back to Claude public quota cache if personal Claude Code OAuth usage is unavailable. 1.0.3.92 Standalone Claude Radar now mirrors the Codex Radar EvenRow visual contract: five compact rings, vertical quota radar line, right-side three-line status panel, and bottom RC/DS/LLM/software row. Rendering still consumes only ClaudeRadarSnapshot/ClaudeCodeUsageReader data and Claude-prefixed caches; DS:-- is a reserved Claude layout slot and must not be populated from Codex DeepSeek state. 1.0.3.93 Standalone Claude Radar bottom metadata removes the DS slot and displays RC/LLM/Claude only. Personal quota accuracy follows community Windows monitor behavior: OAuth usage JSON first, limits-array parsing for newer payloads, and Messages API unified rate-limit headers only as fallback; all upstream used/utilization values are converted to remaining percentages for the quota rings. 1.0.3.96 ClaudeCodeUsageReader setup-token source is shared by Codex Radar Claude mode and standalone Claude Radar; local claude-quota.ini semantics stay unchanged after a successful read. 1.0.4.00 Claude Code personal usage defaults to the passive statusline bridge: Read() reads claude-statusline-quota.ini and installs desktop-codex-statusline-bridge.ps1 only when no custom Claude Code statusLine exists. This default path does not call Claude API/model endpoints and does not spend Claude tokens. ReadViaSetupToken keeps the abandoned setup-token/OAuth/Header parser as a non-default rollback path only. 1.0.4.01 Statusline bridge script is Windows PowerShell 5.1 compatible; do not use ConvertFrom-Json -Depth in the generated powershell.exe script because that parameter prevents any cache write on the target shell. 1.0.4.12 独立 Claude Radar 底部 Claude/RC/LLM 栏只消费 ClaudeRadarSnapshot，不在 paint 路径读取 claude-radar-model-map.ini；claude-radar-cache.ini 保存 CommunityKnown/RatingKey/Label/Average 等社区评分元数据，失败合并和启动缓存必须保留底部栏内容。Scene cache key 包含 community rating key/label，避免底部栏字段变化时复用旧 bitmap。 1.0.4.14 Claude bottom RC uses the highest-average model from claudecoderadar.com model-ratings, with count as tie-breaker. Claude family short labels use two-letter prefixes and Codex-style tiers: Op4.8H, Fa5MAX, So5Ult. 1.0.4.21 Claude Radar Model IQ 时钟为 24 小时顺时针表盘，白点为当前时间指针，小绿点来自选中模型 latest_at，保留 24 小时并在下一圈到达后隐藏；--test-layout 覆盖角度和过期边界。 1.0.4.22 Claude Radar 额度线启用 claudecoderadar.com 的 quota.chart.trend/base_d7_trend/quota.metrics；站点趋势优先，不足两点时读取 claude-radar-quota-history.jsonl 最近 7 天，claude-radar-cache.ini 持久化 QuotaLine* 以保证启动和失败合并保留额度线。 1.0.4.23 Claude Radar 时钟复用 RadarClockTimeDisplayMode，默认 UTC；圆盘 12 点方向绘制绿色竖线，场景缓存包含当前分钟、时间模式和上次尝试刷新时间。 1.0.4.23 Claude Radar R/C/U LED 和 API 摘要共用 ApplyClaudeServiceAlertDebounce；非正常服务错误必须连续存在 10 秒才显示，恢复正常立即清除，随机测试模式旁路防抖。 1.0.4.24 Claude Radar 时钟圆弧在 latest_at 绿点仍有效时从该刷新点顺时针连接到当前白点；绿点按真实年龄满 24 小时隐藏，不再把过期点作为连接弧起点。 1.0.4.27 Claude EvenRow 时钟时间下方绘制 UTC/LAST/REF/NOW 短标签，颜色与时间一致；新增短标签使用独立 modeRect，不得移动或改变既有 dayRect/timeRect2。

feature_name: Claude Radar personal Claude Code usage refresh
reuse: Claude Radar schedules Claude Code usage only when the standalone window is enabled, visible, not suspended, not in random test, and local Claude is running. The reader checks AiRequestProtection before token lookup or HTTP, preserves last good quota on failure, writes only claude-quota.ini on success, and LoadCache overlays that cache at startup. 1.0.3.84 The usage payload is complete only when both 5h and 7d percentage values parse. Successful writes use a shared lock, unique temp file, and atomic replacement; partial responses preserve the last good quota. 1.0.3.96 ClaudeCodeUsageReader setup-token source is shared by Codex Radar Claude mode and standalone Claude Radar; local claude-quota.ini semantics stay unchanged after a successful read. 1.0.4.00 Claude Code personal usage defaults to the passive statusline bridge: Read() reads claude-statusline-quota.ini and installs desktop-codex-statusline-bridge.ps1 only when no custom Claude Code statusLine exists. This default path does not call Claude API/model endpoints and does not spend Claude tokens. ReadViaSetupToken keeps the abandoned setup-token/OAuth/Header parser as a non-default rollback path only. 1.0.4.01 Statusline bridge script is Windows PowerShell 5.1 compatible; do not use ConvertFrom-Json -Depth in the generated powershell.exe script because that parameter prevents any cache write on the target shell. 1.0.4.29 Codex Radar Claude mode and standalone Claude Radar must enqueue Claude Code usage through ClaudeCodeUsageScheduler, not call ClaudeCodeUsageReader.Read directly. The scheduler provides process-wide single-flight, shared 5/10/15 min backoff, one claude-quota.ini write per successful round, and host-only logging for setup-token fallback requests.

window_page: 左下角操作面板 AI 快速选单; 系统设置
reuse: 额度计划只读 Codex Radar 写出的 quota.ini 剩余百分比缓存；缓存超过 45 分钟不触发。默认阈值为周额度小于 3% 且 5 小时额度小于 90%，计划默认关闭。自动截断通过 codex app-server 的 thread/goal/set 写入 usageLimited，恢复写入 active；不要复用 AiExternalToolBlocker 停止进程。app-server 路径优先自动发现 %LOCALAPPDATA%/OpenAI/Codex/bin/*/codex.exe，也可用 DESKTOP_CODEX_APP_SERVER_COMMAND 或 CODEX_CLI_PATH 覆盖。 1.0.3.95 起，额度恢复启用可通过 CodexQuotaPlanResumeConditionMode 选择只看周额度、只看 5 小时额度或两者都恢复；AI 快速选单复用 SettingsFluentResources 的设置页卡片、行、按钮和开关资源。
设置页新增常用/复杂分层时优先复用 AddPageGrouped 的 ! 分组前缀和 AdvancedSectionHeader；外观枚举选择优先复用 VariantPicker，不要重新添加普通 ComboBox；新增缩略图来源必须降级为纯文字且不得在 owner == null 的自测窗口中触发真实窗体渲染。

When promoting a user profile to defaults, update only ApplyUserDefaultSnapshot after backing up settings.ini. Keep refresh/probe counters such as *RefreshToken, *ServiceProbeToken and DeepSeekApiKeyRevision on their zero baseline so new profiles do not inherit stale one-shot triggers.

feature_name: Codex Radar hidden-mode software border suppression
reuse: 隐藏模式颜色保护先绘制到 bitmap 再执行彩色反相；Codex 的蓝色软件族内边框反相后会变成黄橙色，Claude 的橙色内边框也会继续像状态告警。因此 DrawCodexRadarSoftwareInnerBorder 在 IsBurnInColorProtectionActive() 为 true 时必须在绘制阶段直接返回，不要在 ApplyHiddenModeColorProtection 后按像素清理，以免误伤其它彩色内容。缓存 key 已包含 burn-in state，隐藏态和普通态不会互相复用场景 bitmap。
